svg.title: Manaslu — mountain relief
svg.desc: Eastern twin summits at first light. Twin summit profile, narrow true-summit tower, cornices and deeply incised lower spurs. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Ben Tubby. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sunrise,_Manaslu.jpg. License: CC BY 2.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
